messages:
Erin L: Heads-up — noticed a broken link in the Spanish docs when following the localization guide. Visiting /docs/guide/localization?lang=es -> 404. Repro steps below.

Erin L: repro:
```
curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/guide/localization?lang=es
HTTP/2 404
```

Erin L: Looks like frontmatter 'i18n' path points to ../i18n/es/translation.md which doesn't exist in the build output.

Alex B: I'll take a look. Is this happening only for the GA site or also local dev builds?

Erin L: Confirmed on prod, local dev (yarn docs:dev) shows the page but the sidebar link 404s on prod. Possibly a pipeline copy/ignore issue.

Maya P: Might be the new sidebar sync script that filters i18n files. @alex-b fyi — the script was changed in last release (ref #438).

docs-bot: Note: page metadata 'owner' missing for /docs/guide/localization. Please add a doc owner in frontmatter (owner: @alex-b or @i18n-team).

Alex B: Thanks, I'll add owner and push a tiny fix. Plan: add owner, change link to /i18n/es/translation.md -> /translations/es.md (new location), and update sidebar config.

Sam K: If you push a short-lived branch I can do the review quickly. prefer branch name: docs/localization-es-404-fix

Alex B: Pushed branch docs/localization-es-404-fix -> https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/721

Sam K: Reviewing now, should be trivial. Left one nit about relative path in the sidebar.

Alex B: Updated per nit, added frontmatter owner: "Alex B" and TOC fix. CI is green.

Sam K: LGTM :thumbsup:

Maya P: Thanks everyone. Can we add a tiny smoke test to the docs CI to curl known doc URLs? Even just a few critical ones.

Erin L: Yep happy to open a follow-up issue for CI checks.

Alex B: Created issue #912 to add smoke test. Assigning to docs infra.

Erin L: Great, thanks all :pray:
